set(AOM_SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
ensure_build_dir(AOM_BUILD_DIR)
set(AOM_COMPONENT "libaom")

set(AOM_OPTIONS
	"-DENABLE_DOCS=OFF"
	"-DENABLE_EXAMPLES=OFF"
	"-DENABLE_TESTS=OFF"
	"-DENABLE_TOOLS=OFF"
	"-DCONFIG_AV1_ENCODER=1"
	"-DCONFIG_AV1_DECODER=1"
	"-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF"
)

if(FFMPEG_BUNDLED_TYPE STREQUAL "shared")
	list(APPEND AOM_OPTIONS "-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON")
endif()

create_cmake_component(
	AOM_LIBRARY_CREATE_FILE
	"aom"
	"${AOM_COMPONENT}"
	"${AOM_SRC_DIR}"
	"${AOM_BUILD_DIR}"
	"${AOM_OPTIONS}"
	"${FFMPEG_BUNDLED_TYPE}"
	"aom"
	${PLUGIN_LEVEL}
)
include("${AOM_LIBRARY_CREATE_FILE}")

register_plugin(aom "-Dlibaom=enabled")
